name: record_system_feedback
title: Record a gap in projectman
description: Record ONE gap in projectman itself you had to work around (a missing tool, a senseless refusal, a flow that could not do what was asked); the owner decides on it. English, general terms: no secrets, paths, e-mail addresses or names of people, projects or clients. At most 10 new per project a day.

title.description: A short title naming the gap, not the symptom.

what.description: What happened and what projectman could not do.

fix.description: What change in projectman would remove the need for the workaround.

same_as.description: The id (fb_…) of the same gap in list_system_feedback: it only adds an occurrence, the other fields are ignored.
